research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Hamming AI is focused on developing systems for secure updating of machine learning models. This involves a processing device that generates requests and updates models using encryption devices to ensure security. The research also includes encryption retransmission devices for IIoT, enhancing resiliency against attacks by encrypting data and adding headers for secure communication. These efforts highlight Hamming AI's commitment to building reliable AI products through secure and resilient data handling and model updating processes.

about_short_description.short_description: Hamming AI is an experimentation platform that helps teams build reliable AI products.

identifier.value: Automated AI Voice Agent Testing Platform

product.name: Automated AI Voice Agent Testing Platform
product.description: A platform that automates large-scale testing of AI voice agents by simulating thousands of calls with diverse scenarios to identify errors and performance issues before deployment.

product.name: Real-time Production Call Analytics
product.description: A service that monitors live AI voice agent calls, providing real-time alerts and detailed analytics on call quality, latency, hallucinations, and performance degradation.

product.name: Compliance Monitoring and Reporting
product.description: A service that generates detailed reports and audit trails to ensure AI voice agents meet regulatory standards and maintain accountability in production.

product.name: Prompt Optimizer
product.description: A tool that automates the optimization of prompts for large language models by generating and evaluating multiple prompt variants to improve AI task performance.

identifier.value: Selective Scenario Re-runs for Voice AI Testing

product.name: Selective Scenario Re-runs for Voice AI Testing
product.description: A feature that allows users to re-run specific test scenarios from existing datasets to validate changes efficiently without executing the full test suite.
